districtFact: Poway USD publishes student calendar PDFs with the first day of school, last day of school, district recesses, non-student days, professional growth days for staff, holidays, and a separate Abraxas High School student calendar when applicable.

about.title: About Poway USD
about.content: Poway Unified School District (PUSD) serves families in Poway and surrounding San Diego County communities within the San Diego-Chula Vista-Carlsbad metro area. Families searching for a Poway school district calendar often use this page to compare official dates, holidays, district recesses, and school breaks. The district student calendar is the main planning source for first day and last day dates, district recesses, student holidays, non-student days, professional growth days for staff, Thanksgiving Break, Winter Break, mid-winter recess, Spring Break, and major holidays.

about.title: How to Use This Poway USD Calendar
about.content: Use this page for the regular Poway USD student calendar, then confirm school-specific events, testing windows, athletics, graduation details, emergency closures, bell schedules, and same-day announcements through Poway USD or your student's campus. Abraxas High School may follow a separate student calendar.

customSections.label: Poway USD Local Calendar Context
customSections.content: Poway USD calendar planning is especially important for Poway and San Diego County families because the district calendar includes multiple full-week recesses, non-student days, and a separate Abraxas High School calendar. Families commonly use the PUSD calendar for school holidays, transportation routines, childcare planning, enrollment preparation, and academic-year date checks. Check the regular student calendar first, then use campus announcements or the Abraxas calendar if the student follows that alternate schedule.

planningTips.title: Poway USD Calendar Usage Tips
content: Use the regular student calendar PDF for districtwide student dates, recesses, holidays, and non-student days.
Check the Abraxas High School calendar separately if your student follows that alternate schedule.
Plan childcare around non-student days and professional growth days because they fall outside the main recess weeks.
Use the PDF for official review and the ICS file for a one-time personal calendar import.

districtFaqs.q: Does Poway USD publish a separate Abraxas High School calendar?
districtFaqs.a: Yes. Poway USD publishes a separate Abraxas High School student calendar when applicable, including for the 2026-2027 school year.

districtFaqs.q: Where should families verify Poway USD calendar updates?
districtFaqs.a: Use the official Poway USD calendars page and campus announcements for final confirmation. MySchoolDates is an independent reference and is not affiliated with Poway USD.
